mBuff.mDescription: <titleLeft>Grabbed!</titleLeft><mainText>Zac has caught an enemy, and is now looking for a 'friend' to toss them to.</mainText>

mLocKeys.keySummary: Zac attaches his arms to the ground and stretches back, launching himself forward.
mLocKeys.keyTooltip:
Begin Charging: Zac pulls himself taut, charging up a dash over @ChannelTime@ seconds.

Release: Zac launches himself and Knocks Up enemies where he lands for up to @MaxStun@ second (based on charge time), dealing them @Damage@ magic damage. Zac spawns an extra chunk of Goo for each enemy champion hit.
mLocKeys.keyTooltipExtendedBelowLine:
Can be cancelled by moving.
If cancelled, refunds half of the Ability's Cooldown and cost.

mBuff.mDescription: <titleLeft>Knocked up</titleLeft><mainText>This unit has been knocked up by Zac.</mainText>

Cell DivisionEach time Zac hits an enemy with an ability, he sheds a chunk of Goo that can be reabsorbed to restore @f1@ health [4% max health].

Upon taking fatal damage, Zac splits into 4 bloblets that attempt to recombine.
If any bloblets remain after @f7@ seconds, he will revive with 10-50% health based on the surviving bloblet's health. Each bloblet has 12% of Zac's max health, and 50% of his Armor and Magic Resistance. [@f2@ second cooldown]

mLocKeys.keyTooltip:
Each time Zac hits an enemy with an Ability, he sheds a chunk of Goo that can be reabsorbed to restore @HealPercent@ Max Health.

Upon dying, Zac splits into 4 bloblets that attempt to recombine. If any bloblets remain after @ReviveBlobletDuration@ seconds, he will revive with 10-50% Health based on the surviving bloblet's Health. This has a @ReviveCooldown@ second Cooldown.
mLocKeys.keyTooltipExtended:
{{Spell_ZacPassiveChunkDrop_Tooltip}}

Each bloblet has 12% of Zac's max Health, and 50% of his Armor and Magic Resist.

mBuff.mDescription: <titleLeft>Grabbed!</titleLeft><mainText>Zac has caught an enemy, and is now looking for a 'friend' to toss them to.</mainText>

mLocKeys.keySummary: Zac stretches an arm, grabbing an enemy. Attacking a different enemy will cause him to throw both targets towards each other.
mLocKeys.keyTooltip:
Zac stretches his arm out, attaching it to the first enemy hit to deal @TotalDamage@ magic damage and briefly Slow them. Zac's next Attack gains increased range and applies the same damage and Slow.

If Zac hits a different enemy with this Attack, he Knocks Up both towards each other. If they collide, they and surrounding enemies take @TotalDamage@ magic damage and are briefly Slowed.

mBuff.mDescription: <titleLeft>Let's Bounce!</titleLeft><mainText>Zac is getting ready to bounce, making him immune to crowd control and slowing enemies standing on top of him.</mainText>

mLocKeys.keySummary: Zac bounces four times, knocking up enemies hit and slowing them.
mLocKeys.keyTooltip:
Zac bounces @Bounces@ times. The first bounce to hit each enemy Knocks them back and deals @DamagePerBounce@ magic damage. Subsequent bounces deal @DamagePerSubsequentBounce@ magic damage and Slow by @SlowAmount*100@% for @SlowDuration@ second.

Zac gains up to @EndingMS*100@% Move Speed over time and can cast Unstable Matter while bouncing.
mLocKeys.keyTooltipExtendedBelowLine:
Total Damage: @MaxDamageTooltip@ magic damage
Move Speed increases from @BeginningMS*100@% to @EndingMS*100@% over the duration.
During Let's Bounce!, Zac is Ghosted. Ghosted units ignore collision with other units.

mBuff.mDescription: <titleLeft>Bounced!</titleLeft><mainText>This enemy has been knocked up into the air by Zac.</mainText>
<titleLeft>Kidnapped!</titleLeft><mainText>This enemy has become trapped in Zac's gooey belly.</mainText>
<titleLeft>Reconstruction Cooldown</titleLeft><mainText>Zac is able to be reborn. This ability has a @f1@ second cooldown.</mainText>
<titleLeft>Cell Division</titleLeft><mainText>Zac's bloblets are attempting to recombine, and he will revive if they survive.</mainText>
<titleLeft>Cell Division</titleLeft><mainText>Zac's bloblets are attempting to recombine, and he will revive if they survive.</mainText>
<titleLeft>Cell Division Cooldown</titleLeft><mainText>Zac has recently cell divided, and cannot revive himself.</mainText>
<titleLeft>Cell Division</titleLeft><mainText>Zac is able to revive himself upon taking fatal damage.</mainText>

mLocKeys.keySummary: Zac explodes outward towards nearby enemies, dealing a percentage of their maximum health as magic damage.
mLocKeys.keyTooltip:
Zac's body erupts, dealing @BaseDamage@ + @DisplayPercentDamage@ max Health magic damage to nearby enemies.

Absorbing Goo reduces this Ability's Cooldown by 1 second.
mLocKeys.keyTooltipExtendedBelowLine: <rules>Percent Health damage against minions and jungle monsters is capped at 200.</rules>
